# Read in data

Reading in the data with the myeloid subset and the full dataset (including tumor and stromal cells). 

```{r}
so_full <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds"))
so_M <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds"))
```

# Generating differential gene expression for signatures

## Compare inflammatory and ctrl monocytes against other myeloid cells

Using Seurat's `FindMarkers` function, compare inflammatory and ctrl monocytes against other myeloid cells. 

```{r}
dge_inflamm.v.myeloid <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(results_dir, "dge_inflamm-monocytes.v.rest-myeloid.rds"), 
    function() {
        FindMarkers(so_M %>% set_idents("clusters_M"), 
                    ident.1 = "7: inflammatory monocyte")
    }
)
dge_inflamm.v.myeloid %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
    write_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "dge_inflamm-monocytes.v.rest-myeloid.tsv"))

dge_ccr2.v.myeloid <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(results_dir, "dge_ccr2-monocytes.v.rest-myeloid.rds"), 
    function() {
        FindMarkers(so_M %>% set_idents("clusters_M"), 
                    ident.1 = "1: Ccr2+ monocyte")
    }
)

dge_ccr2.v.myeloid %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
    write_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "dge_ccr2-monocytes.v.rest-myeloid.tsv"))
```

```{r}
dge_inflamm.v.myeloid %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
    datatable()
```


```{r}
dge_ccr2.v.myeloid %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
    datatable()
```


Compare the genes in the inflammatory v rest myeloid differential gene expression versus the ccr2 v rest myeloid differential gene expression

```{r}
plot_df <- bind_rows(
    as_tibble(dge_inflamm.v.myeloid, rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(celltype = "inflamm"),
    as_tibble(dge_ccr2.v.myeloid, rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(celltype = "ccr2")
) %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < 1e-4) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = gene,
                names_from = celltype,
                values_from = avg_log2FC) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(direction = ifelse((inflamm * ccr2) < 0, "opposed", "agreed"))
p <- plot_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(inflamm, ccr2, label = gene) +
    geom_point(size = 0.2) 
p +
    geom_text_repel(
        data = ~ ..1 %>%
            filter(direction == "opposed"),
        max.overlaps = Inf, 
        color = "blue"
    ) +
    coord_fixed()
```

An interactive plot. 

```{r}
ggplotly(p)
```

## Compare inflammatory and ctrl monocytes against all cells

```{r}

    filter(clusters_M == "7: inflammatory monocyte") %>% 
    .$cell
cell_ccr2_monocytes <- get_metadata_from_so(so_M) %>% 
    filter(clusters_M == "1: Ccr2+ monocyte") %>% 
    .$cell
```

```{r}
metadata_to_add <- get_metadata_from_so(so_full, metadata = NULL, reduction = NULL) %>% 
    mutate(labelled_monocytes = case_when(
      cell %in% cell_inflammatory_monocytes ~ "inflammatory monocyte", 
      cell %in% cell_ccr2_monocytes ~ "Ccr2+ monocyte"
    )) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell")
so_full <- AddMetaData(so_full, metadata = metadata_to_add)
```

Compare the genes in the inflammatory v rest myeloid differential gene expression versus the other myeloid clusters v rest differential gene expression

```{r}
plot_v_inflamm <- function(dge_df, dge_df_name = "") {
    plot_df <- bind_rows(
    as_tibble(dge_inflamm.v.myeloid, rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(celltype = "inflamm"),
    as_tibble(dge_df, rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(celltype = dge_df_name)
) %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < 1e-4) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = gene,
                names_from = celltype,
                values_from = avg_log2FC) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(direction = ifelse((inflamm * get(dge_df_name)) < 0, "opposed", "agreed"))
p <- plot_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(inflamm, get(dge_df_name), label = gene) +
    geom_point(size = 0.2) + 
    labs(x = "Inflamm. monocytes", y = dge_df_name)
}
```

First the MDSCs. 

```{r}
p <- plot_v_inflamm(dge_MDSC.v.myeloid, "Cluster 0: MDSC")
p +
    geom_text_repel(
        data = ~ ..1 %>%
            filter(direction == "opposed") %>% 
            slice_max(order_by = abs(inflamm) + abs(`Cluster 0: MDSC`), 
                      n = 30),
        max.overlaps = Inf, 
        color = "blue"
    ) +
    labs(caption = "showing top 30 most differential") + 
    coord_fixed()
```

The same plot, but interactive. 

```{r}
ggplotly(p)
```

Now the M2 macs. 

```{r}
p <- plot_v_inflamm(dge_m2.v.myeloid, "Cluster 6: M2 macs")
p +
    geom_text_repel(
        data = ~ ..1 %>%
            filter(direction == "opposed") %>% 
            slice_max(order_by = abs(inflamm) + abs(`Cluster 6: M2 macs`), 
                      n = 30),
        max.overlaps = Inf, 
        color = "blue"
    ) +
    labs(caption = "showing top 30 most differential") + 
    coord_fixed()
```

The same plot, but interactive. 

```{r}
ggplotly(p)
```

# Assessing DGE properties and quality

## compare v myeloid versus v all

Versus all and versus myeloid are honestly not that different. 

```{r}
plot_df <- bind_rows(
    dge_inflamm.v.all %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(dge = "inflamm.v.all"),
    dge_inflamm.v.myeloid %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(dge = "inflamm.v.myeloid")
) %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.0001) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = gene, 
                names_from = dge, 
                values_from = avg_log2FC) 
p <- plot_df %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(inflamm.v.all, inflamm.v.myeloid, label = gene) + 
    geom_point(size = 0.5)
p + 
    geom_text_repel(data = ~..1 %>% filter(inflamm.v.all*inflamm.v.myeloid<0))
ggplotly(p)
```


```{r}
plot_df <- bind_rows(
    dge_ccr2.v.all %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(dge = "ccr2.v.all"),
    dge_ccr2.v.myeloid %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(dge = "ccr2.v.myeloid")
) %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.0001) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = gene, 
                names_from = dge, 
                values_from = avg_log2FC) 
p <- plot_df %>% 
    ggplot() +

p + 
    geom_text_repel(data = ~..1 %>% filter(ccr2.v.all*ccr2.v.myeloid<0))
ggplotly(p)
```

# Create signatures from DGE

## Signatures by top genes

Let's grab those differential gene expression lists that we just derived. 

```{r}
dge_ccr2 <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "dge_ccr2-monocytes.v.rest-ALL.rds"))
dge_inflamm <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "dge_inflamm-monocytes.v.rest-ALL.rds"))
dge_m2 <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "dge_m2.v.rest-ALL.rds"))
dge_mdsc <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "dge_mdsc.v.rest-ALL.rds"))
dge_list <- list(
    Ccr2_monocytes_vs_rest = dge_ccr2, 
    Inflammatory_monocytes_vs_rest = dge_inflamm, 
    M2_macs_vs_rest = dge_m2, 
    MDSC_vs_rest = dge_mdsc
)
```

Define a couple helper functions to pull signatures from the differential gene expression lists. 

```{r}
get_signature_df <- function(dge, gs_name_str, ngenes) {
    dge %>%
        as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>%
        filter(p_val_adj < 0.001) %>%
        slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = ngenes) %>%
        mutate(gs_name = gs_name_str) %>%
        dplyr::select(gs_name, gene)
}

get_gs_from_dge_list <- function(ngenes) {
    dge_list %>%
        imap_dfr( ~ get_signature_df(..1, ..2, ngenes)) %>%
        named_group_split(gs_name) %>%
        map( ~ ..1$gene)
}
```

Get gene set signatures from the DGE lists and save in `r here("data", "signatures")`. 

```{r}
gs_list <- map(set_names(seq(20, 200, 20)), get_gs_from_dge_list)
# gs_list$`20`

saveRDS(gs_list, file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_scRNA_signatures_20.200.rds"))
```


## Monocyte signatures by top unique genes

In order to pull apart the inflammatory monocytes and the Ccr2 monocytes, it may make more sense to generate signatures by the top unique genes instead of simply the top genes, which contain a fair degree of overlap. So let's try that. 

```{r}
dge_ccr2 <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "dge_ccr2-monocytes.v.rest-ALL.rds")) %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
dge_inflamm <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "dge_inflamm-monocytes.v.rest-ALL.rds")) %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
```

```{r}
monocyte_specific_gs_list <- 
    left_join(dge_ccr2, dge_inflamm, by = "gene", suffix = c(".Ccr2", ".Inflamm")) %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj.Ccr2 < 0.0001 & p_val_adj.Inflamm < 0.0001) %>% 
    mutate(direction = case_when(
        avg_log2FC.Ccr2 * avg_log2FC.Inflamm > 0 ~ "same", 
        avg_log2FC.Inflamm > 0 ~ "Inflamm", 
        avg_log2FC.Ccr2 > 0 ~ "Ccr2", 
    )) %>% 
    named_group_split(direction) %>% 
    map(~.$gene)
saveRDS(monocyte_specific_gs_list, file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_scRNA_signatures_Ccr2_and_inflammatory_monocyte_specific_genes.rds"))
```

There are 9 Ccr2-monocyte specific genes. 

```{r}
monocyte_specific_gs_list$Ccr2
```

There are 31 inflammatory monocyte specific genes. 

```{r}
monocyte_specific_gs_list$Inflamm
```

### GO term enrichment of specific signatures

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
go_inflamm_out <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(results_dir, "GO_inflamm.monocyte.specific.rds"), 
    function() {
        gene_conversion <- bitr(monocyte_specific_gs_list$Inflamm, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Mm.eg.db")
        go_inflamm_out <- enrichGO(
            gene_conversion$ENTREZID,
            OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
            keyType = "ENTREZID",
            ont = "BP"
        )
    }
)
go_inflamm_out@result %>% datatable()
```

```{r}
go_ccr2_out <- run_or_readRDS(
```
